# Site Clearance (Kardashev Labs)

> Draw a search area in ERCOT. Get a county-level strong / mixed / weak grade from public GIS queue data, measured interconnection timelines, and LMP stress. Not an official ERCOT study.

Generator GIS filings name a county, not a lat/lon, so the grade is county-resolution. Wire blocks show HIFLD line density and a GridSFM DC power-flow screen matched to your MW; neither enters the grade. SCED curtailment is not in the score.

## Pages

- https://clearance.kardashevlabs.org: map tool
- https://clearance.kardashevlabs.org/methodology: how the grade is built

- https://large-load-tracker.kardashevlabs.org : ERCOT large-load queue context

- https://interconnection-queue.kardashevlabs.org : all-ISO queue search
- https://docs.kardashevlabs.org
- https://kardashevlabs.org
- Score API: `POST https://data.kardashevlabs.org/clearance/score`
